test_cases.test_name: X-bar/R Chart Creation and Nelson Rules Application Test
test_cases.objective: Verify the system can successfully create X-bar/R control charts from CSV data and correctly apply vendor-standard Nelson rules for statistical process control.
prerequisites: System installation completed
Test CSV file with 100k data points prepared
User with appropriate permissions logged in

test_steps.action: Navigate to chart creation module and select X-bar/R chart type
test_steps.expected_result: System displays X-bar/R chart configuration interface with appropriate input fields

test_steps.action: Upload prepared CSV file containing 100k data points using import function
test_steps.expected_result: System successfully loads data within 5 seconds and displays data preview

test_steps.action: Configure chart parameters and enable Nelson rules in settings
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts configuration and shows Nelson rules as active in chart settings

test_steps.action: Generate X-bar/R chart with applied Nelson rules
test_steps.expected_result: System renders complete chart within 2 seconds with Nelson rule violations clearly marked
data_to_capture: Number of Nelson rule violations detected

acceptance_criteria: X-bar/R chart renders successfully within 2 seconds
All 100k data points processed within 5 seconds
Nelson rules correctly identify out-of-control points
No system errors or crashes during process
data_integrity_requirements: Data must remain unchanged during import process
Chart calculations must maintain mathematical accuracy
Statistical rules must be applied consistently

test_cases.test_name: Role-Based Access Control and Data Export Functionality Test
test_cases.objective: Verify the system properly implements role-based access control and supports standard export functionality to PDF and CSV formats as specified.
prerequisites: System installation completed
Multiple user accounts with different roles configured
Sample chart configuration created
Test data set available

test_steps.action: Log in as administrator and create a read-only user role with restricted access
test_steps.expected_result: System successfully creates read-only role with appropriate permissions set

test_steps.action: Log in as read-only user and attempt to modify a released dataset
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents modification attempts and displays access denied message

test_steps.action: Navigate to export functionality and select PDF export for current chart
test_steps.expected_result: System generates PDF file containing complete chart with all data points and annotations

test_steps.action: Select CSV export option for chart data and configuration
test_steps.expected_result: System exports complete dataset and configuration in standard CSV format

acceptance_criteria: Read-only access properly enforced for restricted users
PDF exports contain all chart elements and data
CSV exports maintain data integrity and format
No unauthorized access permitted
data_integrity_requirements: Exported data must match source data exactly
Access controls must prevent unauthorized modifications
Export formats must maintain data structure and metadata

test_cases.test_name: Data Import and Annotation Functionality Test
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system correctly imports data from CSV and ODBC sources and allows users to annotate chart points using built-in features.
prerequisites: OQ dashboard is installed and accessible
Test user account with appropriate permissions is available
Test CSV file with 1000 sample data points is prepared
ODBC data source is configured and accessible

test_steps.action: Log into the SPC dashboard with the test user account.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully authenticates and gains access to the main dashboard interface.

test_steps.action: Navigate to the data import section and select CSV import option.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays CSV import dialog with file selection and mapping options.

test_steps.action: Upload the prepared test CSV file and complete the data mapping process.
test_steps.expected_result: System successfully imports 1000 data points and displays confirmation message.

test_steps.action: Navigate to the ODBC import section and connect to the configured data source.
test_steps.expected_result: System establishes connection and displays available tables/views from the ODBC source.

test_steps.action: Import a dataset from the ODBC source and verify data integrity.
test_steps.expected_result: Data is successfully imported and matches the source data structure and values.

test_steps.action: Create a control chart using the imported data and add annotations to specific data points.
test_steps.expected_result: Chart renders correctly and annotations are successfully attached to selected points.

acceptance_criteria: All data import operations complete without errors
Imported data maintains integrity and matches source data
Annotation functionality works as specified by vendor documentation
System preserves annotations when charts are saved or exported
data_integrity_requirements: Data must maintain accuracy and completeness during import processes
Annotations must be permanently associated with specific data points
Audit trail must record data import events if supported by vendor
urs_requirements: URS-020-005: Users shall annotate points with comments using built-in features
URS-020-012: Import data from CSV and ODBC connections using standard connectors

test_cases.test_name: Performance and Scheduled Reporting Verification Test
test_cases.objective: To validate that the system meets performance requirements for data loading and chart rendering, and that scheduled reporting functions operate correctly.
prerequisites: OQ dashboard is installed and operational
Test dataset of 100,000 data points is prepared
Email server configuration is complete
Scheduled reporting feature is configured

test_steps.action: Import the 100,000 point test dataset into the SPC dashboard.
test_steps.expected_result: Data import completes in less than 5 seconds as specified in performance requirements.

test_steps.action: Apply multiple filter changes to the large dataset and measure chart rendering time.
test_steps.expected_result: Charts render in less than 2 seconds after each filter change.

test_steps.action: Configure a scheduled report using the vendor's scheduler with PDF export.
test_steps.expected_result: Scheduled report configuration is saved successfully with all specified parameters.

test_steps.action: Execute the scheduled report immediately to verify functionality.
test_steps.expected_result: Report generates correctly and is delivered to the specified email address.

test_steps.action: Verify that the exported PDF report contains all required chart elements and data.
test_steps.expected_result: PDF export maintains chart quality and includes all specified data elements.

acceptance_criteria: Data loading performance meets the <5 second requirement for 100k points
Chart rendering performance meets the <2 second requirement after filters
Scheduled reports generate and deliver successfully
Exported reports maintain data integrity and formatting
data_integrity_requirements: Performance metrics must be accurately measured and documented
Scheduled reports must maintain data accuracy during export
Email delivery must be reliable and verifiable
urs_requirements: URS-020-003: The system shall provide vendor standard export to PDF and CSV
URS-020-006: The system shall support scheduled report emails using vendor scheduler
URS-020-010: Load 100k data points in < 5 seconds on supported hardware
URS-020-011: Render charts in < 2 seconds after filter changes

test_cases.test_name: Read-Only Access and Configuration Record Retention Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that released datasets are set to read-only and that chart configurations are retained as controlled records per vendor functionality.
prerequisites: OQ dashboard is installed and accessible
User account with administrative privileges
A previously created and 'released' dataset and chart configuration

test_steps.action: Log into the OQ dashboard with a standard user account.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs into the application.

test_steps.action: Navigate to the dataset that has been previously marked as 'released'.
test_steps.expected_result: The system displays the dataset details.

test_steps.action: Attempt to edit any data point within the released dataset.
test_steps.expected_result: The system prevents editing and displays a message indicating the data is read-only.

test_steps.action: Navigate to the chart configuration associated with the released dataset.
test_steps.expected_result: The system displays the saved chart configuration settings.

test_steps.action: Verify the configuration details match the originally saved settings.
test_steps.expected_result: All configuration parameters are correctly retained and unaltered.

acceptance_criteria: Released datasets cannot be modified by standard users.
Chart configurations are persistently stored and can be retrieved without alteration.
The system behavior aligns with vendor documentation for data control.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Requirements for electronic records to ensure data integrity and prevent alteration.
GMP principles for data governance and control of quality records.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be protected from unauthorized modification after release.
Configuration records must be maintained accurately for audit purposes.

test_cases.test_name: Audit Trail and Active Directory Integration Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system captures an audit trail for configuration changes (if provided by vendor) and integrates with Active Directory for authentication.
prerequisites: OQ dashboard is installed and accessible
Active Directory integration is configured as per vendor instructions
User account with permissions to modify configurations
Access to audit trail logs (if feature exists)

test_steps.action: Attempt to log into the OQ dashboard using Active Directory credentials.
test_steps.expected_result: User is successfully authenticated via Active Directory.

test_steps.action: Log into the application with an admin account and modify a chart configuration setting (e.g., change a Nelson rule parameter).
test_steps.expected_result: The configuration change is saved successfully.
data_to_capture: Screenshot before and after the change

test_steps.action: If the vendor provides an audit trail feature, navigate to the audit log and locate the entry for the configuration change.
test_steps.expected_result: The audit log displays an entry capturing the old value, new value, timestamp, and user who made the change.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the audit trail entry

test_steps.action: If no vendor audit trail is provided, document this finding as 'Not Applicable' per URS.
test_steps.expected_result: Documentation confirms the feature is not part of the standard vendor offering.
data_to_capture: Note confirming absence of vendor-provided audit trail

test_steps.action: Log out of the application and attempt to log in with invalid AD credentials.
test_steps.expected_result: The system denies access and displays an appropriate authentication error.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the login error message

acceptance_criteria: Active Directory authentication functions correctly for valid and invalid credentials.
If available, the audit trail captures configuration changes with necessary details (what, when, who).
The test outcome is accurately documented based on the vendor's feature set.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Requirements for secure, auditable electronic records and user authentication.
Annex 11 - Requires audit trails for critical data changes where technically feasible.
data_integrity_requirements: User actions, especially changes to configurations, should be traceable.

test_cases.test_name: Comprehensive Nelson Rules Application and Out-of-Control Detection
test_cases.objective: Validate that vendor's standard Nelson rules are correctly applied and out-of-control conditions are properly detected and flagged in control charts
prerequisites: System with standard Nelson rules configured
Test datasets with known out-of-control patterns
User with appropriate permissions to create and view control charts
Documentation of vendor's Nelson rules implementation

test_steps.action: Import test dataset containing data points that should trigger each of the eight Nelson rules
test_steps.expected_result: Dataset imports successfully and is available for chart creation

test_steps.action: Create X-bar/R chart with Nelson rules enabled using standard vendor configuration
test_steps.expected_result: Chart is created with Nelson rules applied and visible indicators for rule violations

test_steps.action: Systematically verify each Nelson rule detection by examining data points that should trigger specific rules
test_steps.expected_result: System correctly identifies and flags violations for all eight Nelson rules according to vendor specification
data_to_capture: Visual indicators for each rule type

test_steps.action: Verify that non-violating data patterns are not incorrectly flagged as out-of-control
test_steps.expected_result: System does not generate false positive violations for in-control data patterns

acceptance_criteria: All eight Nelson rules are correctly implemented according to vendor specification
Out-of-control conditions are accurately detected and visually flagged
No false positive detections for in-control data patterns
Rule violations are consistently applied across different chart types
regulatory_basis: ICH Q2(R1) - Validation of analytical procedures
data_integrity_requirements: Accurate application of statistical rules
Consistent detection of out-of-control conditions
Reliable flagging of rule violations without data alteration
urs_requirements: URS-020-002: Users shall apply vendor's standard Nelson rules
URS-020-001: Users shall create X-bar/R and p-charts from CSV inputs
related_tests: OQ-001: X-bar/R Chart Creation and Nelson Rules Application Test
OQ-003: Data Import and Annotation Functionality Test
